# Educational component photographs

These photographs illustrate construction, not the modeled 1968 Fender specimen.
Original image bytes are retained unmodified; browser display scales them without
cropping. No association or endorsement by the photographers is implied.

- `6l6gc-joe-haupt.jpg`: Joe Haupt, “Vintage RCA Blackplate 6L6GC Vacuum Tubes
  Made For McIntosh, Made In USA,” 2014.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vintage_RCA_Blackplate_6L6GC_Vacuum_Tubes_Made_For_McIntosh,_Made_In_USA_(15643635699).jpg
  CC BY-SA 2.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/
  This photograph remains under that license; no edits.
- `speaker-nubert.jpg`: Günther Nubert / Nubert Speaker Factory,
  “12zollhinten.jpg,” public-domain release as documented at
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:12zollhinten.jpg
  Illustrates a Nubert loudspeaker, not an Oxford or Fender driver.

Licensing/source pages inspected November 20, 2026. Full attributions and source
